Initial release of smyx-anxiety-behavior-recognition-analysis

- Analyzes fixed-camera footage (home/office) to detect hand rubbing, nail biting, and pacing behaviors linked to anxiety.
- Outputs statistics for each behavior: frequency (events/hour), total duration, and an anxiety-behavior index (0-100).
- Provides real-time monitoring with customizable reminders when anxious behaviors increase.
- Supports history queries and personal baseline tracking for self-monitoring or counselor use.
- Includes strict open-id verification for data security before any analysis or history retrieval.
